# Mardou Museum asset

- `MardouMuseumResult.glb`
- Source: user-supplied `the-mardou-museum.zip`
- Exporter metadata: Outerspace Software GLB Exporter
- Runtime use: primary ROOM museum architecture

The GLB is self-contained; its six referenced images are embedded in the
binary file, so the loose `textures/` copies from the archive are not needed
at runtime.
